task_objective: Implement the dataset-columns-and-right-click plan: make every Dataset Catalog column user-resizable and anchor context-menu actions to the right-clicked row.

test_rewritten.name: test_catalog_all_columns_are_user_resizable
test_rewritten.rationale: The plan deliberately replaces Folder Stretch behavior with user-resizable fixed widths. The rewritten test checks every logical column's Interactive mode and resize round-trip while retaining the FolderColumnDelegate assertion.

design_decisions: The context menu resolves self._view.indexAt(position), where position is already viewport-relative.
rowIntersectsSelection(index.row()) preserves a row that is selected through another cell. isSelected(index) and isRowSelected(index.row()) both fail for SelectItems selection behavior.
Blank-space clicks resolve to None and disable all context actions instead of inheriting a stale currentIndex().
DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTHS is (120, 220, 300, 90, 180). An assertion requires this tuple to match CatalogModel.columnCount() so new columns cannot be silently unsized.

setStretchLastSection and all auto-fit behavior remain absent because they would make a column non-resizable. The accepted visible consequences are no Folder auto-growth and a horizontal scrollbar at narrow dock widths.

red_green_results.right_click_red: 3 failed, 19 passed: target click returned alpha instead of delta; an unselected row stayed unselected; blank-space actions stayed enabled. The cell-preservation test passed before the fix, as expected.
red_green_results.column_width_red: 3 failed, 21 passed: column 2 was Stretch, DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTHS was absent, and widening changed Folder from 236 to 736 pixels.

mutation_verification.V1_context_anchor: Replacing _resolve_context_target with _selected_entry caused 3 failures and 1 pass: the delta target, unselected-row selection, and blank-space action tests failed.
mutation_verification.V2_row_membership: Replacing rowIntersectsSelection with isSelected(index), then isRowSelected(index.row()), each caused test_catalog_right_click_inside_the_existing_selection_preserves_it to fail. In both runs selection changed from {(1, 2)} to {(1, 0)}.
mutation_verification.V3_resize_mode: Restoring Stretch on column 2 caused test_catalog_all_columns_are_user_resizable to fail on the mode assertion and test_catalog_widening_the_dock_leaves_user_column_widths_alone to fail as Folder changed from 88 to 588 pixels.

quality_gates.catalog_dock_test_count: 24 passed; 18 original tests with one rewritten and 6 added

deferred_and_unverified: On-screen confirmation is deferred: offscreen tests prove modes, sizes, selection state, and action enablement, not real mouse-divider feel or context-menu placement. Validate in a windowed session with ./run.sh uv run wherewolf-desktop.
The narrow-dock horizontal scrollbar is an accepted but not on-screen-tested consequence. Default widths total 910 pixels; no test asserts scrollbar appearance.
Column widths do not persist across restart. This remains absent and out of scope.
Multi-selection batch actions remain out of scope. Remove still acts on the one anchored row; plan 3b owns batch behavior.
